summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Fleet security disposition is evidence_needed. Do not clear security-sensitive releases or new public exposure. Concrete evidence: security fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt readiness are therefore unknown. TLS has no expirations within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is mixed at 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. Recommendation: maintain existing private launch gates and permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. This is evidence triage, not certification or proof of compromise.

Keep security-sensitive releases and new public exposure blocked until dated control evidence exists. Use only authorized metadata and retained artifacts to document authentication/access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS coverage, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, alter permissions/configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.

Keep SearchWoot private. Security/release evidence is blocked because the consolidated control matrix is incomplete and operations/fleet-doctor results are unavailable. No public beta, notification expansion, monetization change, or rights-dependent launch is cleared. Reconsider only after access, secrets, isolation, release, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, data-exposure, and disclosure evidence is recorded with owner approval.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and private launch gates
items.summary: Security clearance is not supportable from the current read-only baseline. Preserve private launch and security-sensitive release gates while completing one consolidated evidence matrix; do not infer vulnerabilities from missing telemetry or claim certification.
items.requested_action: Continue bounded read-only evidence capture using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record timestamps, affected scope, owners, severity, exact unknowns, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain risk, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it introduces no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Keep SearchWoot private and do not conduct external outreach.
